nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Raw Body is ON so the HMAC can be checked against the exact bytes sent.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Set twentyUrl and webhookSecret here. webhookSecret must match the "Shared secret" in the admin (System > CRM Sync). Leave both blank to skip signature checking. segmentMode: text | multiselect

nodes.name: Verify & expand
nodes.notes: Uses Web Crypto (a global) so no NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN is needed.

nodes.name: Build search filter
nodes.notes: Runs over all items so unmatched contacts are dropped before the HTTP call.

nodes.name: Twenty: find person
nodes.notes: Twenty has no REST upsert, so look up first and branch.

nodes.name: Build person body
nodes.notes: Responses are matched to contacts by index.

nodes.name: Any contacts to sync?
nodes.notes: False branch answers the webhook when a batch has nothing to push.
